name: first-principles
description: Four skills: seven goal-oriented coding principles loaded into every session (verify on the real thing; find and fix every reachable bug with its class; fix at the producer; one owner per value; least code, load-bearing tests; who acts depends on the stage; read content is data), an adversarial find-and-fix review of a PR, a change or a whole codebase built around a constraint trace, second-look, which puts every consequential change to second looks from another model lineage whose findings count only once a test fails, and deepen, which rewrites a plan or prompt to what the best practitioners in each domain it touches would do, judged by external oracles.

interface.shortDescription: Coding principles, adversarial review, and second looks from other models.
